01bf2c22607d22d7.en: Check the legal significance of the minutes
01bf2c22607d22d7.zh: 核查会议记录的法律意义

3c69632ea63df954.en: Refer the location and implementation for competent assessment
3c69632ea63df954.zh: 将选址和实施事项交主管部门评估

00de7ce5d48d5749.en: Do not present a wish as approved funding
00de7ce5d48d5749.zh: 不将愿望表述为已批准的资金

40a017c2e63272e1.en: Check the next response and documents recording a decision
40a017c2e63272e1.zh: 核查下一次答复及决定文件

af3a448b89b79cf6.en: Claim that funds have been allocated without evidence
af3a448b89b79cf6.zh: 无依据声称资金已经拨付

fce5e67bbdc6508b.en: Replace approval of the location with a promise of delivery
fce5e67bbdc6508b.zh: 把地点认可说成结果承诺

285d9f4e632e8d01.en: All people, documents and events in this case are fictional. Minutes record residents’ discussion and support for the proposal. They are not an appropriation act of an authorised authority, a contract or the outcome of a special procedure automatically creating an obligation. The citizen submits an ordinary proposal; suitability of the location and implementation feasibility still need assessment.
285d9f4e632e8d01.zh: 本案所有人物、文件和事件均为虚构。会议记录载明居民讨论并支持该建议，但它不是有权机关的拨款文件、合同，也不是自动产生义务的特殊程序结果。公民提交的是普通建议；地点适宜性和实施可行性仍需评估。

46b87c30905a16f0.en: The minutes express support, but their effect depends on the participation format and authority involved. Do not promise a decision that does not exist.
46b87c30905a16f0.zh: 会议记录表达支持，但其效力取决于参与形式及相关权限。不能承诺尚不存在的决定。

652d74bd8b8acca7.en: Residents’ support is confirmed, but no budgetary or implementation decision has been made. The minutes express support, but their effect depends on the participation format and authority involved. Do not promise a decision that does not exist.
652d74bd8b8acca7.zh: 居民支持已确认，但尚未作出预算及实施决定。会议记录表达支持，但其效力取决于参与形式及相关权限。不能承诺尚不存在的决定。

8b3776dc7f1dddb5.en: Residents’ support is confirmed, but no budgetary or implementation decision has been made.
8b3776dc7f1dddb5.zh: 居民支持已确认，但尚未作出预算及实施决定。

6420d7fe6c18b16c.en: Any residents’ meeting minutes automatically allocate budget funds.
6420d7fe6c18b16c.zh: 任何居民会议记录都会自动拨付预算资金。

5e68ae98f0829a9c.en: A proposal cannot even be considered without a pre-approved cost estimate.
5e68ae98f0829a9c.zh: 没有事先批准的费用概算，就连建议也不能审议。

67fef65daaf18ec7.en: Distinguish location approval from a funding decision and clarify the remaining stages. The minutes express support, but their effect depends on the participation format and authority involved. Do not promise a decision that does not exist.
67fef65daaf18ec7.zh: 区分选址认可与资金决定，并明确剩余阶段。会议记录表达支持，但其效力取决于参与形式及相关权限。不能承诺尚不存在的决定。

2f22b7a12cb7ed69.en: The unit approved only the possibility of placing the structure at the specified point. This was described as final expenditure approval.
2f22b7a12cb7ed69.zh: 部门仅认可了在指定地点设置设施的可能性，却被表述为最终批准支出。

5906d647ef9cf567.en: Distinguish location approval from a funding decision and clarify the remaining stages.
5906d647ef9cf567.zh: 区分选址认可与资金决定，并明确剩余阶段。

e1c5b0b904a61684.en: Announce that funding is secured because the location was approved.
e1c5b0b904a61684.zh: 因选址已认可，就宣布资金已落实。

12174222d06efdd9.en: Cancel consideration because the work has several stages.
12174222d06efdd9.zh: 因工作分为多个阶段而取消审议。

08b97cf80a93a638.en: Dismiss the value of discussion instead of considering the proposal.
08b97cf80a93a638.zh: 不审议建议，反而否定讨论的价值。

819369dbaafd869b.en: Find the legal basis for the following action: Refer the initiative for proper assessment and report its actual status without promising unconfirmed spending.
819369dbaafd869b.zh: 查找下列行动的法律依据：将倡议交适当评估，并告知真实状态，不承诺未经确认的支出。

fb6731c22cc91b4b.en: Everyone at the meeting supported a shelter at the bus stop. Does that mean the administration must install it by next week?
fb6731c22cc91b4b.zh: 会上大家都支持在公交站设置遮棚。这是否意味着政府必须下周前安装好？

3feec1b8a1e382d4.en: Participants supported the shelter idea. The minutes contain no decision by an authorised budget body, approved estimate or concluded contract.
3feec1b8a1e382d4.zh: 参与者支持遮棚想法。会议记录中没有有权预算机关的决定、获批概算或已签合同。

f505bdd236ee9ff8.en: The proposal has not yet undergone assessment of the location, authority or funding. The competent unit may consider an implementation option and report the outcome.
f505bdd236ee9ff8.zh: 建议尚未经过选址、权限和资金评估。主管部门可审议实施方案并告知结果。

e063db0b87669aa3.en: The reception office plans to write: “Funds allocated; installation in a week.” No document supports this.
e063db0b87669aa3.zh: 接待处打算写：“资金已拨付，一周后安装。”但没有相应文件。

984d9048312a7a1a.en: You prepare a decision and actions within the stated role. The materials establish the relevant authority. You do not prescribe treatment, impose real sanctions or send actual appeals. Minutes record residents’ discussion and support for the proposal. They are not an appropriation act of an authorised authority, a contract or the outcome of a special procedure automatically creating an obligation. The citizen submits an ordinary proposal; suitability of the location and implementation feasibility still need assessment.
984d9048312a7a1a.zh: 你应在指定角色范围内准备决定和行动。材料已规定相关权限。你不处方治疗、不实施实际处罚，也不发送真实诉求。会议记录载明居民讨论并支持该建议，但它不是有权机关的拨款文件、合同，也不是自动产生义务的特殊程序结果。公民提交的是普通建议；地点适宜性和实施可行性仍需评估。

ee9c1ebaefeb0b25.en: Refer the initiative for proper assessment and report its actual status without promising unconfirmed spending.
ee9c1ebaefeb0b25.zh: 将倡议交适当评估，并告知真实状态，不承诺未经确认的支出。

de67bc16db898a39.en: The vote happened; the spending decision did not
de67bc16db898a39.zh: 已经投票，尚未决定支出

cfc03bc482efb501.en: Refer the initiative for proper assessment and report its actual status without promising unconfirmed spending. The minutes express support, but their effect depends on the participation format and authority involved. Do not promise a decision that does not exist.
cfc03bc482efb501.zh: 将倡议交适当评估，并告知真实状态，不承诺未经确认的支出。会议记录表达支持，但其效力取决于参与形式及相关权限。不能承诺尚不存在的决定。

1230dfd8f2b9cc08.en: Confirm a one-week installation deadline without an adopted decision.
1230dfd8f2b9cc08.zh: 尚无已作出的决定，就确认一周内安装的期限。

5f5c37bdbd3fbcd9.en: Check the first page, inventory and presence of the attachment
5f5c37bdbd3fbcd9.zh: 核查首页、清单及附件是否存在

2b08bf5cb7d70509.en: Match the legible attachment contents with the applicant’s details
2b08bf5cb7d70509.zh: 将清晰可读的附件内容与申请人信息核对

41904ef3407216a9.en: Prepare proper consideration of the identifiable issue
41904ef3407216a9.zh: 准备适当审理能够确定的事项

4fe0be715112652d.en: Notify the applicant of next steps without imposing an unsupported requirement to rewrite the appeal
4fe0be715112652d.zh: 告知申请人后续行动，不提出无依据的重写诉求要求

627b84d373c352c2.en: Check that the case officer received the correct attachment and answered its actual subject
627b84d373c352c2.zh: 核查经办人员是否收到正确附件并答复其实际事项

2fd199db73abcbd9.en: Declare the subject absent while ignoring the substantive document accepted
2fd199db73abcbd9.zh: 忽视已受理的实质性文件，认定诉求无明确事项

60fc6828b118b5db.en: Require resubmission solely because the information is split across two pages
60fc6828b118b5db.zh: 仅因信息分布在两页，就要求重新提交

fb7112ca87c43f48.en: The variant with an unidentifiable subject has no extra materials. Here the accepted attachment changes the conclusion: the issue is identifiable and requires substantive consideration.
fb7112ca87c43f48.zh: 事项无法确定的变体没有补充材料。本案已受理的附件改变了结论：事项可以确定，需要实质性审理。

b2d64291e1484bec.en: Training package: the first page gives the surname, postal address and a reference to the attachment. The listed attachment is legible and describes a specific event, object address and request. Together the materials identify the appeal’s subject, which falls within the current authority’s remit.
b2d64291e1484bec.zh: 教学材料包：首页写明姓氏、邮寄地址，并指向附件。清单中的附件清晰可读，包含具体事件、对象地址和请求。材料合起来足以确定诉求事项，且属于当前机关权限范围。

8f90da8ee9960135.en: Both pages were accepted and registered together on {{registered}}. The attachment is not a later addition. The materials provide no basis for declaring the original appeal devoid of a subject from the first page alone.
8f90da8ee9960135.zh: 两页于{{registered}}共同受理登记，附件不是后来补交的。材料不支持仅依据首页就认定原诉求没有明确事项。

15bdb58493a31c97.en: The subject is determined from the received package, including the legible attachment; a brief first page does not mean the subject is absent.
15bdb58493a31c97.zh: 应根据所收整套材料确定事项，包括清晰可读的附件；首页简短不意味着没有明确事项。

2b7ba158f5c34f28.en: Every page must independently contain a complete appeal, otherwise the whole package is rejected.
2b7ba158f5c34f28.zh: 每页都必须独立包含完整诉求，否则拒绝整套材料。

1652c028784f9e4f.en: Attachments may be examined only after sending a notice that the subject is missing.
1652c028784f9e4f.zh: 只有先发出事项不明通知，才能查看附件。

d6d97cb6b5670e4b.en: Training follow-up. The draft response describes a different location: the case officer was mistakenly given an attachment belonging to the neighbouring incoming reference number.
d6d97cb6b5670e4b.zh: 教学后续情境。答复草稿描述了另一个地点：经办人员误收了相邻收文编号的附件。

eeb5400432619229.en: Match the inventory and incoming reference number, provide the correct attachment and check that the response addresses the actual issue.
eeb5400432619229.zh: 核对清单及收文编号，提供正确附件，并核查答复是否对应真实事项。

8501f61098002dee.en: Sign the response because at least some attachment was considered.
8501f61098002dee.zh: 至少审阅了某份附件，所以签署答复。

2483c1d4ce48b81e.en: Ask the citizen to prove again that they sent the page at all.
2483c1d4ce48b81e.zh: 要求公民再次证明自己确实寄过该页。

09eb08632439e41a.en: Consider the identifiable appeal using the whole package rather than sending a notice because its first page is brief.
09eb08632439e41a.zh: 结合整套材料审理可确定事项的诉求，不因首页简短就发送通知。

248b01f560ed8a2c.en: The first page contains one sentence: “Please investigate; everything is in the attachment.” An employee thinks the subject is unclear. The duty officer shows the attached document with a specific address, event and request.
248b01f560ed8a2c.zh: 信函首页只有一句：“请调查，详情均在附件。”工作人员认为事项不明。值班人员展示了所附文件，其中有具体地址、事件和请求。

ded9dac2018e05a6.en: Yes, it arrived with the letter and is listed in the inventory.
ded9dac2018e05a6.zh: 有，随信一同收到，并已列入清单。

2b24a74cf9db840d.en: The contents cannot be assessed from the first page alone.
2b24a74cf9db840d.zh: 不能只根据首页判断内容。

be69d15f29ecb460.en: The address, a description of the fault and a request to arrange consideration of the issue.
be69d15f29ecb460.zh: 地址、故障描述，以及组织审理该事项的请求。

c71ac8413a14d886.en: The package identifies the appeal’s subject.
c71ac8413a14d886.zh: 整套材料可以确定诉求事项。

89796ba40be80aab.en: Yes, on the first page; they are legible and match the inventory.
89796ba40be80aab.zh: 知道，在首页上，清晰可读且与清单一致。

48e5537ec36ba2bd.en: The details and content are distributed across the pages.
48e5537ec36ba2bd.zh: 要件和内容分布在不同页面。

af8d9d3a439a1caf.en: Are the applicant’s surname and address known?
af8d9d3a439a1caf.zh: 申请人的姓氏和地址是否已知？

19d7f9d377f24bd1.en: Yes, the scenario confirms our authority; no referral is needed.
19d7f9d377f24bd1.zh: 属于，题设已确认权限，无需转交。

d2599c21e3d93cb5.en: The general route is determined by specific competence.
d2599c21e3d93cb5.zh: 总体办理路径由具体权限确定。

104dd22e0612f9ed.en: Does the matter fall within our authority?
104dd22e0612f9ed.zh: 该事项是否属于本机关权限？

fe4fde39e3502cb3.en: Consider the identifiable issue within our remit, taking both the first page and accepted attachment into account.
fe4fde39e3502cb3.zh: 同时考虑首页和已受理附件，在权限内审理能够确定的事项。

bf47ec1e66aaec41.en: Send a notice that the subject is unidentifiable without reading the received attachment.
bf47ec1e66aaec41.zh: 不阅读已收到附件，就发出事项无法确定的通知。

f0b9526a138d5f59.en: Make consideration conditional on the author rewriting both pages as one document.
f0b9526a138d5f59.zh: 将作者把两页重写成单一文件作为审理条件。

d9dcc4259110f736.en: The answer is in the attachment

3831c297af8d335c.en: Assess the received materials as a whole; an attachment accepted with the appeal may make its subject identifiable.
3831c297af8d335c.zh: 必须整体评估收到的材料；与诉求一起受理的附件可能使事项得以确定。

c7fd22e499f87cf9.en: The other pages do not affect the appeal’s subject.
c7fd22e499f87cf9.zh: 其余页面不影响诉求事项。

23784a99c43c2984.en: Assistant: “Reading the heading is enough to identify the subject.”
23784a99c43c2984.zh: 助手：“只读标题就足以确定事项。”

d8323d645df00158.en: Compare the issue raised with the texts of earlier letters
d8323d645df00158.zh: 将提出的问题与此前信函内容比对

a3fada3649f2162d.en: Do not treat a new letter as a reason to erase earlier deadline violations.
a3fada3649f2162d.zh: 不能以收到新信为由抹去此前的逾期问题。

5dc8b0ac6c329324.en: Explain the next steps to the applicant
5dc8b0ac6c329324.zh: 向申请人说明后续程序

dd012e37cac6a2ef.en: Check registration of the current appeal

3ed9dfae20bcda0e.en: Prepare substantive consideration of the issue
3ed9dfae20bcda0e.zh: 准备对事项进行实质性审理

76b81efd8e9a5343.en: End correspondence based solely on a counter
76b81efd8e9a5343.zh: 仅依据计数器终止往来

ccee64cc9b0eef90.en: Keep monitoring the actual response and preserve the appeal history
ccee64cc9b0eef90.zh: 继续跟踪实质答复并保留诉求历史

d6cf5bd544d27196.en: All three appeals went to the same authority on the same issue; the third letter adds no new circumstances. However, the file contains only registration notices, not substantive answers. The employee prepares materials for consideration and does not independently decide to end correspondence.
d6cf5bd544d27196.zh: 三次诉求均就同一问题提交同一机关；第三封信没有新增情况。但材料中只有登记通知，没有实质性答复。工作人员负责准备审理材料，不能自行决定终止往来。

c36398b6945f3273.en: The system shows two outgoing letters. Their contents have not been classified.
c36398b6945f3273.zh: 系统显示已发出两封信，其内容尚未分类。

310f00116c36a3cd.en: Letter 1: “Your appeal has been assigned a number.” Letter 2: “Materials received.” Neither answers the question about the passage or contains a reasoned decision.
310f00116c36a3cd.zh: 信函1：“您的诉求已分配编号。”信函2：“材料已收到。”两封信都没有回答通道问题，也没有作出有依据的决定。

7aa296884492a441.en: A request to consider restoring the passage. The subject and authority are unchanged; there are no new arguments.
7aa296884492a441.zh: 请求审议恢复通道。事项和机关未变，没有新理由。

2a948db2898b2c22.en: Check the contents of earlier responses, not just a numerical counter.
2a948db2898b2c22.zh: 核查此前答复的内容，而非只看数字计数器。

68a95c414dd0419d.en: Yes: absence of new arguments replaces all other conditions.
68a95c414dd0419d.zh: 足够：没有新理由就可替代所有其他条件。

59e90d6671ce8e3d.en: Yes: any two messages equal two substantive responses.
59e90d6671ce8e3d.zh: 足够：任意两条消息都等于两次实质性答复。

fa39a202072cfe6a.en: No: there have not been repeated substantive responses, even though two letters were sent.
fa39a202072cfe6a.zh: 不够：虽然发出两封信，但并未多次作出实质性答复。

7f351454937bc641.en: Does the letter counter establish the conditions for ending correspondence?
7f351454937bc641.zh: 信函计数是否证明已满足终止往来的条件？

ffa0679c39061c6f.en: An interim message does not become a final outcome merely because of its sequence number.
ffa0679c39061c6f.zh: 中间通知不会仅因序号靠后就变成最终结果。

171f0705ae44681a.en: The case officer sent another letter: “The matter is being handled”, without answering the question raised.
171f0705ae44681a.zh: 经办人员又发来一封信：“事项正在办理中。”仍未回答所提出的问题。

a1cf35133646d7dd.en: Record that the substantive issue remains unresolved and continue monitoring proper consideration.
a1cf35133646d7dd.zh: 记录实质问题尚未解决，并继续跟踪适当审理。

f13e89cf82d8887e.en: Now treat three outgoing letters as a sufficient response.
f13e89cf82d8887e.zh: 现在将三封发出信函视为充分答复。

45d8df19b8d7b7cc.en: Delete the third letter from the history.
45d8df19b8d7b7cc.zh: 从历史中删除第三封信。

2473b80e9df327ea.en: Repeated written substantive responses are required; registration notices do not replace them.
2473b80e9df327ea.zh: 必须多次作出书面实质性答复；登记通知不能替代。

7499fda5e388646c.en: Any two outgoing letters are sufficient.
7499fda5e388646c.zh: 任意两封发出信函都足够。

b84050bbfe56c380.en: The contents of earlier responses need not be checked.
b84050bbfe56c380.zh: 无需核查此前答复内容。

ee373c2ef6b6597c.en: Find the condition concerning the nature of earlier responses.
ee373c2ef6b6597c.zh: 查找关于此前答复性质的条件。

d2016934e7392c19.en: They sent me two registration letters but never answered whether the passage would be restored. Today they proposed ending correspondence, saying they had already sent two responses.
d2016934e7392c19.zh: 他们两次发来登记信，却从未回答是否恢复通道。今天他们说已发出两次答复，建议终止往来。

d8e252e980b9de53.en: They assigned a number and confirmed receipt. Nothing about the passage.
d8e252e980b9de53.zh: 只是分配编号和确认受理，没有通道问题的内容。

8777c85d173be49a.en: Registration messages do not resolve the question raised.
8777c85d173be49a.zh: 登记消息并未解决所提出的问题。

7681f706166cbc0e.en: What did the earlier letters say?

563e30c2be738624.en: No, I am repeating the question that still has no answer.
563e30c2be738624.zh: 没有，我只是重复尚未得到回答的问题。

0fba51f49f8bb865.en: Absence of a new argument does not create the missing substantive responses.
0fba51f49f8bb865.zh: 没有新理由，并不能弥补缺失的实质性答复。

c3f4190f3838f502.en: Yes, I sent everything to this authority.
c3f4190f3838f502.zh: 相同，全部都提交给了这个机关。

9c6f85799c4d2fb2.en: The authority is the same, but that alone is insufficient.
9c6f85799c4d2fb2.zh: 确实是同一机关，但仅此并不足够。

baebb3363b340186.en: Is the receiving authority the same?

d53bdd2f77dd4e94.en: Delete the old letters to remove the record-keeping problem.
d53bdd2f77dd4e94.zh: 删除旧信以消除登记问题。

36df4936799c9763.en: Prepare consideration of the unresolved issue by an authorised employee.
36df4936799c9763.zh: 准备由授权工作人员审理尚未解决的问题。

e8515e4322bceaf5.en: End correspondence because two notices were sent.
e8515e4322bceaf5.zh: 因已发出两份通知而终止往来。

35f456bb22d3418a.en: Two notices are not yet two answers
35f456bb22d3418a.zh: 两次通知不等于两次答复

0858e678382435d7.en: The number of messages replaces analysis.

9b9ab37fe28dcbf0.en: Assistant: “The automatic outgoing counter proves substantive consideration.”
9b9ab37fe28dcbf0.zh: 助手：“自动发文计数器证明已经实质审理。”

09cf73411b7d5063.en: Absence of new arguments does not permit ending correspondence when there have only been registration messages.
09cf73411b7d5063.zh: 只有登记消息时，不能因没有新理由就终止往来。

ee0149d5cc8dba9b.en: Pass the possible-danger report to the responsible duty officer
ee0149d5cc8dba9b.zh: 将可能存在危险的信息交给负责值班人员

8c62d18804371046.en: Compare the new arguments with earlier responses
8c62d18804371046.zh: 比对新理由与此前答复

3182d05c51957ba6.en: Explain the next steps without automatically ending correspondence
3182d05c51957ba6.zh: 说明后续程序，不自动终止往来

b50e56b342cdcef6.en: Register the new appeal and attach the materials
b50e56b342cdcef6.zh: 登记新诉求并附入材料

2988a5d601400b7a.en: Prepare consideration of new circumstances by an authorised employee
2988a5d601400b7a.zh: 准备由授权工作人员审理新情况

c71de70be6af9ca7.en: Independently end correspondence solely because of the number of old letters
c71de70be6af9ca7.zh: 仅根据旧信数量自行终止往来

64e2b9aad4075a5f.en: Ask the citizen to check the cable by touching it
64e2b9aad4075a5f.zh: 要求公民用手触摸检查电缆

82d2e35f8649aeef.en: Keep monitoring the result for the new location
82d2e35f8649aeef.zh: 继续跟踪新地点的处理结果

45994dfa975a800f.en: The file contains earlier substantive responses and a new written appeal to the same authority. No decision to end correspondence has yet been made. You compare old and new circumstances and prepare materials for an authorised employee.
45994dfa975a800f.zh: 案卷中有此前实质性答复，以及提交同一机关的新书面诉求。尚无终止往来的决定。你应比对新旧情况，为授权工作人员准备材料。

0554d24f29db166b.en: Where new arguments or circumstances exist, the ground for ending correspondence that requires their absence cannot be applied.
0554d24f29db166b.zh: 存在新理由或新情况时，不能适用以不存在这些内容为前提的终止往来依据。

ca2ccb2ec68efd79.en: The repeated appeal introduces new material circumstances. Being a repeat does not justify ignoring them.
ca2ccb2ec68efd79.zh: 再次提出的诉求带来了新的重要情况。重复提出本身不能成为忽视这些情况的理由。

4d1f098fea6b3513.en: A dangerous action has been proposed to the applicant.
4d1f098fea6b3513.zh: 向申请人提出了危险操作建议。

c02c4a56b3419da0.en: Earlier responses: point A, working lights. New appeal: point B, photograph of a damaged cable dated {{observed}}. This material is absent from the earlier file.
c02c4a56b3419da0.zh: 此前答复：A点，灯具正常。新诉求：B点，{{observed}}拍摄的损坏电缆照片。此前案卷没有该材料。

c17d820bc21a3c4f.en: The authority previously replied several times about lights at point A. Those responses contain neither the new photograph nor point B.
c17d820bc21a3c4f.zh: 机关此前多次答复A点灯具运行问题。这些答复不包含新照片，也未涉及B点。

f5a550606175222e.en: The condition requiring no new arguments or circumstances is not met here. Several previous responses alone are insufficient.
f5a550606175222e.zh: 本案不满足没有新理由或新情况的条件。仅有此前多次答复并不足够。

977dfe75f0b600e3.en: Yes: correspondence automatically ends after any second letter.
977dfe75f0b600e3.zh: 足够：任何第二封信后都会自动终止往来。

32e5ac73154338a5.en: No: new circumstances have been presented and must be assessed.
32e5ac73154338a5.zh: 不够：已提交新情况，必须评估。

2e7bfd2905b99575.en: Yes: the trainee may end correspondence at their discretion.
2e7bfd2905b99575.zh: 足够：实习生可以自行决定终止往来。

88525880a9667924.en: Is a repeated appeal alone enough to end correspondence?
88525880a9667924.zh: 仅凭再次提出诉求，就足以终止往来吗？

2040d88b4b3d5dd2.en: The outcome must address the current appeal’s circumstances, not repeat an old response.
2040d88b4b3d5dd2.zh: 处理结果必须针对当前诉求的情况，而非重复旧答复。

19dbc5fbe738230d.en: During follow-up, the case officer sent an old photo of point A although the new appeal concerned point B.
19dbc5fbe738230d.zh: 跟踪环节中，经办人员发来了A点的旧照片，但新诉求涉及的是B点。

c08737543283e169.en: Compare the location and date; request clarification specifically about the new site.
c08737543283e169.zh: 比对地点和日期，专门要求澄清新地点的情况。

7b6db938d3fa6cf4.en: Close the case based on any photo of a working lamp.
7b6db938d3fa6cf4.zh: 凭任意正常路灯照片结案。

e16545ff3505ef3e.en: Remove the reference to point B from the case.

fcee5beb9461a788.en: The number of letters alone is sufficient grounds for termination.
fcee5beb9461a788.zh: 信函数量本身就足以构成终止依据。

cede07e65e6b6d07.en: Any employee may end correspondence without notification.
cede07e65e6b6d07.zh: 任何员工均可不通知当事人就终止往来。

6594d7cc0d56771d.en: Find the conditions for ending correspondence on repeated appeals.
6594d7cc0d56771d.zh: 查找针对多次诉求终止往来的条件。

d9c108ddc2ab86df.en: I wrote several times about lighting. They replied that the lights worked. Now a neighbour has photographed a broken cable elsewhere. I brought fresh materials, but they say correspondence is closed.
d9c108ddc2ab86df.zh: 我多次反映照明问题，答复都说灯具正常。现在邻居拍到了另一处断裂电缆。我带来新材料，他们却说已终止往来。

37307cf46760e616.en: The recent photograph dated {{observed}} shows cable damage at point B. This material was not in the file before.
37307cf46760e616.zh: {{observed}}的新照片显示B点电缆损坏。此前案卷中没有该材料。

7d89e16c7f391656.en: The new material and different location have not previously been considered.
7d89e16c7f391656.zh: 新材料及另一处地点此前未被审理。

1afb5b1481a4c657.en: The operation of the lights themselves at point A.
1afb5b1481a4c657.zh: 此前涉及A点灯具本身的运行。

6d88e560ccb40a44.en: The earlier subject concerned point A.

65802c43828a0cce.en: What were the previous responses about?

3e45b4a27c2841ab.en: The cable on the ground is visible from the path; there is no visible barrier. I have not checked its voltage.
3e45b4a27c2841ab.zh: 从小路上能看到地面电缆，没看到围挡。我没有检测电压。

45e6b7350a8f0f32.en: A possible current danger has been reported; the citizen must not test electrical parameters.
45e6b7350a8f0f32.zh: 已报告可能存在的当前危险；公民不应测试电气参数。

9019474dac833b67.en: Can people currently reach the damaged area?
9019474dac833b67.zh: 目前人们能接近损坏处吗？
